title: Albums since 2015
statementMd:
List albums released in 2015 or later.

Expected columns: `title`, `release_year`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, release_year FROM albums WHERE release_year >= 2015;
```
